futureValidationDesign.quota: Stop on provider limit/auth failure; no key fallback or credit purchase; validate provider billing evidence, not just UI.
futureValidationDesign.isolation: Bind owner/session generation/thread/turn on every event; reject late A replies after B login; isolate persisted histories and credentials; validate reconnect and interrupted turns.
futureValidationDesign.revoke: Test local logout separately from provider revoke; prove old credential refusal and unaffected other owner without retaining secrets.
